description_expanded: AboutHakuna Matata on 30A | Blue Mountain Beach Luxury Vacation Rental | Golf Cart Included Why Guests Love Staying at Hakuna Matata on 30A • Fantastic location in Blue Mountain Beach along Scenic Highway 30A • Easy beach access just minutes away • Six-person street legal golf cart included for effortless trips to the beach and exploring 30A - Golf Cart being added March 23, 2026 • Bikes included for riding along the scenic 30A bike path • Gated community offering privacy, security, and resort-style amenities • Resort amenities including a community pool, gym, cornhole, shuffleboard, and putting green • Four backpack beach chairs and beach umbrella provided for stress-free beach days • Four bedrooms plus a bunk space and three and a half bathrooms sleeping up to ten guests • Three king bedrooms including a luxurious primary king ensuite • Open concept living area perfect for gathering and relaxing • Fully stocked kitchen designed for easy vacation meals and entertaining • Outdoor grill ideal for family cookouts after a day at the beach • Third floor screened outdoor sitting area with outdoor television and plenty of seating • Dedicated office with desk for remote work or quiet planning time • Family friendly amenities including games, books, pack and play, and high chair • Close to the best dining, shopping, and entertainment along 30A • Minutes to popular local favorites including Mimo’s Italian Restaurant, Red Fish Taco, and Blue Mountain Creamery Your Blue Mountain Beach Escape Along Scenic 30A Welcome to Hakuna Matata on 30A, a beautifully designed vacation retreat located in the heart of Blue Mountain Beach along Scenic Highway 30A. Thoughtfully designed for families and groups, this spacious four bedroom plus bunk space home offers the perfect combination of comfort, style, and convenience for your next 30A beach vacation. Situated in a gated resort-style community, Hakuna Matata on 30A places you close to everything guests love about Blue Mountain Beach and Santa Rosa Beach. Sugar white sand beaches, turquoise Gulf waters, local restaurants, boutique shopping, and outdoor adventures are all just minutes away. With a six-person street legal golf cart and bikes included, exploring 30A is effortless. Cruise to the beach, ride along the scenic bike path, or venture out to discover some of the area's most popular dining and entertainment spots. Open Concept Living Designed for Connection Step inside and discover a bright and welcoming open concept living space designed for relaxing after long days in the sun. The spacious living room offers comfortable seating, coastal inspired décor, and plenty of room for everyone to gather. Large windows fill the home with natural light, creating an inviting atmosphere that instantly feels like vacation. Whether you are enjoying movie night, planning tomorrow’s beach adventures, or simply unwinding with family and friends, the living area is the heart of the home. For entertainment, guests will find a selection of games, books, and family friendly activities, ensuring there is something for everyone to enjoy. Fully Stocked Kitchen for Effortless Vacation Dining The fully stocked kitchen makes preparing meals during your stay easy and enjoyable. Guests will find everything needed to cook breakfast before heading to the beach or prepare dinner after a day of exploring. Kitchen highlights include: • Quality cookware and bakeware • Full sets of dishes, utensils, and serving pieces • Modern appliances and generous counter space • Plenty of room for meal prep and entertaining The adjacent dining area offers the perfect setting for shared meals, board games, or simply gathering together after a full day along 30A. Outside, the outdoor grill allows guests to enjoy casual cookouts and fresh seafood dinners under the Florida sky. Comfortable Bedrooms Designed for Rest and Privacy Hakuna Matata on 30A comfortably sleeps up to ten guests across four bedrooms plus a bunk space, offering both privacy and flexibility for families and groups. Bedroom Layout • Primary King Suite featuring a private ensuite bathroom and spacious accommodations • Second King Bedroom offering comfort and privacy • Third King Bedroom designed with relaxing coastal décor • Queen Bedroom perfect for additional guests • Twin over twin bunk space ideal for kids and teens Each bedroom includes comfortable bedding, thoughtful design details, and plenty of space to unwind after a day at the beach. Third Floor Screened Outdoor Living Area One of the most unique features of Hakuna Matata on 30A is the third floor screened outdoor sitting area. This elevated retreat offers plenty of comfortable seating and an outdoor television, creating the perfect space for evening relaxation. Enjoy morning coffee with a coastal breeze, watch your favorite game outdoors, or gather with friends for sunset conversations after a day of beach adventures. Dedicated Office Space for Remote Work For guests needing to stay connected during their stay, the home also features a dedicated office with desk. Whether catching up on work, checking emails, or planning your daily excursions along 30A, this quiet workspace adds extra convenience. Resort Style Community Amenities Guests staying at Hakuna Matata on 30A enjoy access to outstanding resort-style amenities, including: • Large community swimming pool • Fitness gym • Cornhole area • Shuffleboard courts • Putting green These amenities provide fun and relaxation for guests of all ages without ever leaving the community. Everything You Need for the Perfect Beach Day Beach days are easy and stress free with four backpack beach chairs and a beach umbrella included. Simply load up the six-person street legal golf cart and head to one of the nearby beach access points just minutes away. The included bikes are perfect for exploring the famous Scenic 30A bike path, offering a fun way to visit nearby communities, coffee shops, and coastal attractions. Prime Blue Mountain Beach Location Hakuna Matata on 30A is ideally located near some of the most popular destinations along Scenic Highway 30A. Nearby favorites include: • Blue Mountain Beach access known for its soft sand and beautiful Gulf waters • Blue Mountain Creamery for ice cream and coffee • Red Fish Taco for casual coastal dining • Mimo’s Italian Restaurant for a delicious evening out • Boutique shopping and art galleries along 30A • Scenic bike paths and coastal dune lakes This central location allows guests to easily explore Grayton Beach, Santa Rosa Beach, and other beloved 30A communities. Family Friendly Amenities for Stress Free Travel Families traveling with young children will appreciate the thoughtful extras provided at Hakuna Matata on 30A, including: • Pack and play • High chair • Games and books for all ages These details help ensure a comfortable and convenient stay for guests of every generation. Your Perfect 30A Vacation Awaits With its incredible location, thoughtful amenities, spacious layout, and relaxing coastal style, Hakuna Matata on 30A delivers everything guests look for when booking a Blue Mountain Beach vacation rental. From beach days and bike rides to sunset dinners and evenings relaxing on the screened porch, every moment here is designed to help you slow down, unwind, and embrace the carefree spirit of the Gulf Coast. Book your stay at Hakuna Matata on 30A and discover why guests return year after year to experience the best of Blue Mountain Beach and Scenic Highway 30A.
